About the Project

The Leipzig School of Human Origins recruits doctoral researchers studying human evolution and related questions. Applicants should choose a research track and potential supervision that fits their academic preparation, then follow the School's call requirements.

Research Areas

  • Human evolution
  • Anthropology
  • Evolutionary research

About Max Planck Society

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.
